New evidence used PMIDs 39167807, 38446675, 33577729, 36495879, 41371238, 42285113, 34904799, 39550172, 33667670, 39250535, 35123662, 34784425, 27332626, 24944260, 24713413, 27922936, 30798284, 41039299, 22335736, and 28806470, with duplicate source PMIDs reused for closely related worklist topics where the same verified comparison applied. Four topics were rejected because verified ClinicalTrials.gov/PubMed evidence did not provide a valid numeric comparator effect: repotrectinib Nsclc, bexarotene Mycosis Fungoides, bexarotene Leukemia, and droxidopa Dopamine Beta Hydroxylase Deficiency.
